start.text: The shift is over. The traffic that did not fit was almost always one page, from one browser name.
start.name: Joshua

A.text: Good work. The lesson is the same every time: share the load, limit each visitor, and close what stays open.
A.name: Carla

B.text: Some of the new cards [b][color=green]Cap[/color][/b] the enemy's turn. Point at the word to read it. No hit does more than the Cap says.
B.name: Carla

C.text: So a big hit becomes a small one, even when I do not have the Block for it. And I buy the upgrade my clues point at.
C.name: Joshua

D.text: Exactly. Use your Security Points, and read what your clues recommended.
D.name: Carla

E.text: Understood. Spare capacity, a limit for each visitor, and no connection left open.
E.name: Joshua
